todo: Purpose: Lay working and abandoned rail alignments from a small connected family while retaining transport ownership.
Visual brief: Two readable rails on sleepers for the steam line; a distinct continuous guideway for maglev. Rails converge only at a designed turnout, with broken/disused rails visibly disconnected.
Implement after review: Claude selects the design, draws it, supplies exact anchors/collision and passes the library gate; no concept may ship.
Geometry: proposed authoring envelope 3x6 cells; one cell is 8 world px / 24 art px. This is not an asserted solid footprint; collision, foot and overhang await the drawing.
Widths: Proposed 3-cell track bed; segment lengths 3/6 cells; turns are authored connected parts rather than arbitrary rotation.
Rule proposal: every rail connector meets one compatible connector on the same tier and declared line; buffers terminate lines.
Active train collision, crossing timing and transport costs remain outside W0.
